name: Public-domain photo plate
description: A photograph (museum public-domain or licensed asset) mounted as a paper plate: duotone to the style's ink and paper, deckled paper margin, rect/niche/disc window or a sticker-edged cut-out for alpha PNGs, lifted shadow.

implementation.api: Studio.kit.mythic.plate(parent, {src, x, y, w, h, frame, duotone, border}) -> piece

validation.evidence: Kit self-test tests/test-mythic.py (Playwright Chromium: build, seek determinism) and frame review of the mythic-film scaffold (portrait) on Windows, 2026-11-23. Not yet rendered through HyperFrames on the Apple M2 host, so not approved.
